A '''silverbloom bush''' was a type of [[Bush/Legends|bush]]. [[Russell Wake]], a [[Gardener/Legends|gardener]] who lived on<ref name="Secret weapon" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]], mercilessly dealt with [[Plant/Legends|weeds]] that choked his silverbloom bush.<ref name="Secret weapon" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> after agreeing to help [[Ferus Olin]], a member of [[the Eleven]] resistance group, Wake reflected that despite the way he handled the weeds that choked his silverbloom bush, he had previously not been brave enough to consider resisting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Secret weapon" />

==Behind the scenes==
A silverbloom bush was mentioned in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'', a [[2007]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the seventh installment in the ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Secret weapon" />
